scope_limit: Sophia Integrity is currently bounded to preparing and reviewing supplied manuscript, citation, provenance and integrity-related evidence for authorised human review. It does not determine plagiarism or misconduct, decide authorship, impose discipline, decide publication, or create an institutional integrity finding.
review_pack_title: DIO Sophia Integrity Controlled Evidence Review Pack
human_gate_reason: Academic-integrity findings, misconduct determinations, authorship decisions, disciplinary action, publication decisions and final release remain with authorised humans and institutions.
